scientific_conclusions: Track3 correctly distinguishes four raw summary QK scores from probabilities. The4-8-1 conditional-independent feedforward model has40 weights+9 biases and samples both hidden and output bits. Exact marginal training is valid for this proposed behavior model; device transfer is explicitly unvalidated.

The primary selector output is variable. Mandatory first/last-two blocks bypass the network and BCE, count as probability1 in expected work, and are deduplicated at short prefixes. The grouped average budget is not a hard quota. Complete query/head groups are required; drift, P95, peaks and overflow are explicitly measured.

Existing source supports both variable and fixed modes. The512-slot TLM raises on variable overflow. Fixed8 is correctly used as a historical quality reference and Track4 isolation control, not imposed as the user's architecture. An independent mean8 example has38.35% probability of exceeding8 blocks, illustrating why the documented capacity policy is necessary.

Track1 keeps three FFN projections, fixed deterministic W8 at inference, shared64/stratified thresholds, shared gate/up input draws and independent z recoding. It clearly permits newly trained W8 codes while retaining old-code controls and requires deployment-faithful forward/export validation rather than treating quantization-only QAT as proven stochastic-compute training.

Track4 keeps the actual finite CTMC trajectory in forward and separates biased QK proxy gradients from actual V/O derivatives. Its local V/O loss is measured after O, while whole-network training is explicitly not called an unbiased exact path gradient. It correctly requires a new causal training wrapper because the current evaluator is eval-only and its multi-token path uses SDPA.

Track2 retains three projections and a continuous up branch, uses deterministic tanh conversion before finite bipolar samples, constrains alpha/gamma and expands layers only after validation. It makes no equivalence claim for replacing SiLU and does not conflate activation sampleN with FFN T or Ising S.

Dataset revisions, server resources, executor, capacity strategy and quality tolerance remain pre-execution freeze items; all training budgets and the3-1-4-2 ordering are explicitly proposals. No new result, checkpoint, GPU allocation, hardware measurement or fifth research direction is presented as completed.
